players.product: AI-Native Cloud: inference cloud (Inference Engine, serverless inference) and GPU Droplets on NVIDIA HGX and AMD Instinct GPUs, integrated with its Core Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: DigitalOcean entered an equipment finance facility to fund purchases of data center equipment for capacity expansion; it intends to use it to acquire GPU, CPU and other required equipment to meet customer demand for its AI-Native Cloud, adding capacity for 2027 and 2028. CFO Matt Steinfort: 'We remain highly confident in our guidance for Q3 and the full year 2026 as well as in our outlook for 2027.'
